info.title: Talki — Scoring Service API
info.description: Microservicio del bounded context Speech Analysis (DDD) del producto Talki. Consume el evento fillers.analyzed del exchange talki.events, calcula el Voice Coach Score con 5 dimensiones (fluency, clarity, volume, vocabulary, confidence) cada una validada en el rango 0-100, y publica scoring.completed. Aplica idempotencia at-least-once mediante unique constraint sobre session_id + manejo de DataIntegrityViolationException.
